verdict.rationale: Column's docs explicitly cover domestic wires (with raw message access), RTP and FedNow send/receive/RFP through unified APIs, plus a unified transfers query endpoint across payment types, all under one OpenAPI-defined API surface. Per-rail nuances (e.g., wire raw data, simulate endpoints for sandbox testing) are documented, meeting the developer story well. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of RTP/FedNow origination beyond docs, and more granular per-rail limits/SLA documentation.
